content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Birmingham

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMI Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific thresholds for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus years of direct project experience, or alternative education/experience combinations. Verify your qualifications before investing in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full curriculum PMI mandates. Complete all contact hours to satisfy the formal-education requirement for your application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, create your PMI profile and formally apply for the PMP credential. Upload proof of your education and project experience. Pay PMI's examination fee to activate your application and schedule your exam window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam at your convenience. Pass the comprehensive assessment to earn your PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn and report professional development units (PDUs) across PMI's three-year renewal cycle. Renew your credential before expiration to keep it active. Staying current keeps your PMP credential recognized throughout your career in your local job market.
